SUMMARYMicrosoft Certified Power Platform Developer (PL-900) nearly 3 years’ experience in Canvas Apps, Model-DrivenApps, and Power Automate for enterprise process automation. Skilled in integrating Power Apps with SharePoint,Dataverse, SQL Server, and Excel to build scalable, high-performance solutions. Proficient in UI/UX design, dataintegration, application optimization,Power BI dashboards,, ETL automation. Adept at delivering end-to-endprojects, reducing manual effort, and improving data accuracy.SKILLSEDUCATIONM.C.ACERTIFICATIONSPROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCEPune Maharashtra shraddhapatil28108@gmail.com+917448222344SHRADDHA PATIL Software EngineerPower PlatfromDeveloperCybage Software August 2024 -PresentMicrosoft Power Platform Power AppsCanvas AppsModel Driven AppPower Automate Power Virtual AgentsPower PagesDataverseSharepoint IntegrationBusiness Process Automation Workflow OptimizationUI/UX Design for AppsWorkflow OptimizationPower AutomateProject Name CSU-ENT-PowerAppsAutomationMicrosoft PowerPlatform FundamentalsPL-900

Design and develop custom solutions using Microsoft PowerPlatform tools, including Power Apps & Power Automate, toaddress diverse business requirements and challenges.

Developed custom business apps including Canvas Apps,SharePoint Form Apps to meet specific organizationalrequirements.

Created custom connectors and solutions to extend and customizeMicrosoft applications and services.

Collaborated with stakeholders and project team members todesign and implement enterprise Microsoft Dynamics solutions,ensuring high quality and reliability. NorthMaharashtra University Jalgaon.2014-2017Project Name : HR & Admin ApplicationsAssociate Software Engineer Netlink SoftwareNovember 2022-July 2024

Designed and developed a centralized licence allocation andmanagement application for HR & Admin teams using Canvas Appsintegrated with Dataverse as the backend data store.

Automated licence request approvals and allocation workflows withPower Automate, enabling real-time status updates, emailnotifications, and audit trail generation.

Reduced licence processing time from 3 days to 1 day by eliminatingmanual approvals and paper-based tracking.

Developed Canvas Apps and SharePoint-integrated apps to automateinternal workflows such as leave requests, asset allocation, andemployee onboarding, reducing manual processing time by 40%

Integrated Power Apps with Dataverse and SQL Server for centralizeddata storage, ensuring consistency and reliability across systems.Project: Employee Onboarding Automation

Developed a fully automated onboarding solution where new employeedata entry in Power Apps triggered approval workflows in PowerAutomate, automatically creating user accounts, assigning assets, andupdating HR databases.

Integrated Power BI for onboarding status tracking and SLA reporting.Reduced onboarding completion time from 5 days to 2 days andeliminated manual follow-ups.
